name: Railway
description: Monitor Railway workspaces for 2FA, TLS on public domains, employee access and production availability

config.name: Authorization
config.setupInstructions:
1. In Railway, open Account Settings → Tokens
2. Name the token and select the workspace you want reviewed
3. Create the token from a workspace admin account (member 2FA status is only visible to admins)
4. Paste it below

credentialFields.label: Railway Token
credentialFields.helpText: Railway > Account Settings > Tokens > Create, scoped to the workspace you want reviewed.

checks.name: Two-Factor Authentication
checks.description: Verify every Railway workspace enforces 2FA and every member has two-factor authentication enabled

checks.name: TLS on Public Domains
checks.description: Verify every Railway public domain serves a valid, non-expiring TLS certificate over HTTPS

checks.name: Employee Access
checks.description: Verify every Railway workspace member is an active employee, and that no leaver retains access

checks.name: App Availability
checks.description: Verify every Railway production service has a live deployment
